about.title: Make A Statement
about.body: Welcome to Endless Hair by Hasibe — an exclusive boutique salon where style and craftsmanship come together. In a warm, inviting atmosphere, we offer a complete hair salon experience tailored to your unique personality and desires.
about.body2: We work exclusively with high-quality, natural and vegan products from renowned brands. Our specialist stylists combine years of experience with an eye for the latest trends, ensuring a flawless result — from a simple trim to a complete transformation.
about.body3: Whether you come for a fresh new look, an effective hair treatment, or a relaxing pampering session — you are at the heart of everything we do. Discover the difference of personal attention, passion for the craft, and impeccable service.

aboutPage.title: About Endless Hair by Hasibe
aboutPage.subtitle: Our Story
aboutPage.text: Endless Hair by Hasibe is an exclusive boutique salon located in the heart of Heemskerk. With a deep passion for the hairdressing craft and an eye for detail, we offer a wide range of premium hair services for both women and men. Our salon is known for its warm, professional approach, use of top-quality products, and commitment to perfection.
aboutPage.text2: We believe beautiful hair starts with a personal approach. That's why we take the time to listen to your wishes and create a tailor-made treatment. Our stylists continuously follow the latest techniques and trends, ensuring you always leave with a stylish and well-groomed result.
